Read goal, set progress 80 with the same note, read back progress 80/version 2/one note. Setup, sign-in, tool discovery and model reasoning excluded. Browser and native WebMCP use the local companion same-origin proxy to the hosted API, including 3 automatic snapshot refreshes; direct HTTP calls go straight to the hosted API.
